def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    final_count = 0
    
    if input_line:
        chars = list(input_line)
        prev = chars[0]
        count = 1
        
        for i in range(1, len(chars)):
            if chars[i] == prev:
                count += 1
            else:
                if count % 2 == 0:
                    final_count += 1
                prev = chars[i]
                count = 1
        
        if count % 2 == 0:
            final_count += 1
    
    print(final_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
